get.description:
This tenant's events.

They were stored and reachable only by an id somebody already held — so replaying a delivery
meant knowing the event id in advance, which is precisely what an operator investigating a
failure does not have.

schema.title: Response List Events Api V1 Webhooks Events Get
Response Replay Event Api V1 Webhooks Events  Event Id  Replay Post

get.description:
Every knob an operator may change, with its current effective value.

Built from the settable set, so a credential, a DSN or a frozen identifier cannot appear here
even by accident — the filter is in one place rather than repeated per field.

schema.title: Response Effective Config Api V1 Webhooks Operator Config Get

put.description: Override one policy value. Refused if the boot guard would refuse it.

schema.title: Response Set Config Api V1 Webhooks Operator Config Put

delete.description: Drop an override so the configured default applies again.

schema.title: Response Clear Config Api V1 Webhooks Operator Config  Key  Delete

get.description:
Which credentials are set, and a four-character hint for each.

There is no value in this response and no route that would return one. The hint exists so an
operator can tell which key is loaded before replacing it — replacing the wrong one is the
mistake this prevents.

schema.title: Response List Secrets Api V1 Webhooks Operator Secrets Get

put.description:
Set or rotate a credential. The previous one stays valid for a bounded window.

Audited BEFORE the write: a change the log cannot take must not happen, and here the old value
is overwritten by the action itself, so an unrecorded rotation is unreconstructable.

schema.title: Response Set Secret Api V1 Webhooks Operator Secrets Put

delete.description: Remove a credential so the configured environment value applies again.

schema.title: Response Clear Secret Api V1 Webhooks Operator Secrets  Name  Delete

post.description:
Redact the subject out of event payloads, inbound bodies and delivery responses.

Rows are redacted, not deleted: the delivery history is how an operator answers "did it ever
arrive?", and a payload with a key removed can crash a consumer that replays it. The person
leaves; the shape stays.

schema.title: Response Erase Subject Internal Privacy Erase Post
